summary: To become accomplished or complete. Completion belongs to Becoming because not every process is endless.
placement: Selected from a numerically integrated rabinovich trajectory to distribute stars across its projected shape. This is an artistic placement, not linguistic evidence.

satellites.title: Formation, Abiding, Decay, Emptiness
satellites.evidence: The Abhidharmakośa divides a great eon into four ages of twenty intermediate eons each: 成住壞空, formation, abiding, destruction and emptiness, eighty in all. A world completes itself, lasts, comes apart, and lies empty before forming again.

checked.note: 如是所說成住壞空，各二十中，積成八十，總此八十…

gaps: Check the Sanskrit names of the four ages (vivarta, saṃvarta …) in the Kośabhāṣya and Monier-Williams.

satellites.title: Helping Others Complete What Is Good in Them
satellites.evidence: Analects 12.16: 君子成人之美，不成人之惡 — the exemplary person brings others’ good to completion, and does not bring their bad to completion. 成 is something done for someone else.
